# PingPath

> PingPath by Andreas Ink is an iOS app for blind and visually impaired people to explore indoor surroundings with spatial audio, AI captions, voice questions, and LiDAR.

## Official information
- [Product and frequently asked questions](https://www.pingpath.app/): Features, device compatibility, and experimental pathfinding limitations.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pingpath-blind-ai-tools/id1644421594): Current version, compatibility, pricing, and download.
- [Support guide](https://andreas.craft.me/nnL9M4RftSjD6F): Product support.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.craft.do/s/ePRw8bs20jJPdy)
- [Terms of use](https://www.craft.do/s/1bBGHgNwxDQxbA)

## Capability limits
Pathfinding is an early experimental feature and should not be used without someone to assist with navigation. The app is optimized for LiDAR-enabled phones and also works with standard cameras; capabilities differ by hardware. Consult the current App Store listing for compatibility and pricing.
